name: Breaker test-cabinet interface
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Shows the secondary-control connection between a withdrawn breaker and its selected test cabinet.
description: Shows the secondary-control connection between a withdrawn breaker and its selected test cabinet. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test cabinet supply and controls” at the input and “Breaker secondary interface” at the output. The test cabinet is equipment-specific.

Trace the source and destination on each side of the test boundary. Use the selected test-device instructions for actual operations and never infer a safe current-transformer switching sequence from an educational diagram. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
